name: Authorization Boundary Bypass
description: Attempt to access an object or operation without satisfying the authorization policy required for that resource.
preconditions: The application exposes protected resources or operations.
Authorization is enforced inconsistently or incorrectly.
indicators: A user can access another user's resource.
A lower-privileged role can perform a privileged action.

name: Object Identifier Manipulation
description: Changing a user-controlled object identifier to test whether server-side authorization is enforced for the referenced resource.
preconditions: Object identifiers are exposed to the client.
The server resolves objects using client-controlled identifiers.
indicators: Changing an identifier returns another user's resource.
Authorization depends only on object existence.

name: Injected Query Input
description: Supplying crafted input to determine whether application data is interpreted as part of a backend query or command.
preconditions: User-controlled input reaches a query or interpreter.
Input is not safely parameterized or separated from query structure.

name: Credential Reuse
description: Use of valid credentials obtained from another context to access an application or resource.
preconditions: Credentials are valid for the target system.
The attacker has obtained or reused credentials.
indicators: Authentication from unusual context or location.
